description: THE ONLY Renovate config file — do not add another (a second config file such as .github/renovate.json5 silently shadows this one; see the same note in shapepipe).
forkProcessing is enabled because this repo is a GitHub fork of martinkilbinger/shear_psf_leakage; Renovate skips forks by default.

Same policy as shapepipe / sp_validation / cs_util: all non-major updates grouped into one weekly PR that automerges when CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: uv sync --frozen + pytest on py3.12) is green; majors gated behind a dashboard-approval tick; security fixes automerge off-schedule; lockFileMaintenance refreshes uv.lock weekly. uv owns resolution; rangeStrategy=update-lockfile means in-range releases land as lockfile bumps rather than pyproject edits.

Upper caps: for a release outside the declared range, update-lockfile falls back to replace, which rewrites a range like >=1.13,<1.18 into >=1.18,<1.19 and so drops the cap. A deliberate cap therefore needs its own packageRule (rangeStrategy in-range-only, or allowedVersions) alongside it.
